Name: Maggs Dusky Interface Sebastian Theme
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url][color=#f1f1f1]![/color]

[color=#f1f1f1][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
Full interface recolor featuring muted grays, purples, and a few Sebastian-themed details. Not blatantly themed, so works with any character if you like the color scheme!

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url]!

Includes optional recolored assets for these mods:
[b]GMCM and Event Lookup folders:[/b]
Included assets for Generic Mod Config Menu and Event Lookup, open the Maggs Interface folder, then the GMCM or Event Lookup folder and drag the "assets" file into your GMCM or Event lookup mod folder, then replace (or Merge on Mac).

[/color][b]StardewMagic folder:[/b]
Replaces the mana bar. Open the Maggs Interface folder, then the StardewMagic folder and drag the "assets" file into your StardewMagic[b] [C][/b] mod folder, then replace the duplicate file (or Merge on Mac). Note: make sure you only replace the mana_bar.png, and don't delete all the other assets.[color=#f1f1f1]

Mods shown in screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]

[/color][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=4]Permissions[/size][/color][/b]
Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. I worked heckin’ hard on this mod, would hate to see it uploaded by someone who didn’t do the work.
